about.bio: I’m originally from Newcastle. Alongside my degree I work part-time as a Junior Associate at Zaltek Digital, where I’ve worked since 2022. I write about economics and markets here, and I build data and finance projects in Python and TypeScript, all of which are open on GitHub.
about.ownWords: I’m a second-year Economics and Finance student at Queen Mary, and I’ve never been able to learn something by just following the steps, so I end up building things like an option pricer from scratch until I understand why it works. Writing it up is the last part of that, and it’s usually where I find out whether I actually got it. I’m applying for internships for next summer and will keep adding to this as I go.
